rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterising whether braking is executed when needed. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking behaviour itself as the subject of evaluation, rather than merely an influencing control mechanism. H-1 and FR-7 support the obstacle-related driving scope. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure management, or unsupported timing behaviour.
determining_elements: “Braking-maneuver execution state” directly identifies the system behaviour needed to evaluate whether required braking is omitted.
The scope restricts assessment to driving situations involving obstacles or road users where braking may be required to avoid collision, consistent with H-1 and FR-7.
The reference to obstacle-detection/braking scenarios provides operational context without making obstacle-detection mechanisms or their timing part of P.
